prompt: A reader enters at three. Which exit should they use at half past four?
promptZh: 讀者三點進來，四點半應從哪個出口離開？

options.text: Go out through the gate used on arrival
options.zh: 從進來的庭園入口出去
options.whyZh: 人在庭園內無法解鎖該入口。

options.text: Walk back through the library lobby
options.whyZh: 大廳是平常的出口，但四點半已關閉。

options.text: Ask the caretaker to let them out through the service yard
options.zh: 請管理員讓他從後勤院區離開
options.whyZh: 庭園入口無法從內側解鎖，大廳已關閉，而五點前可經後勤院區離開。

options.text: Wait until five for the lobby to reopen
options.zh: 等到五點再從重新開放的大廳離開
options.whyZh: 五點是庭園關閉時間，通知沒說大廳屆時會重開。

explanationZh: 庭園入口無法從內側解鎖，大廳已關閉，而五點前可經後勤院區離開。
evidence: The garden gate unlocks only from the street. / Normally, exit through the lobby. / It closes at four; until the garden closes at five, the caretaker lets you out through the service yard.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The garden gate unlocks only from the street.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: It closes at four; until the garden closes at five, the caretaker lets you out through the service yard.
